tools.name: opfor_list_evaluators
tools.description: List all available Opfor evaluators and suites. ALWAYS call this before opfor_setup — never assume evaluator IDs. Returns each evaluator's id, name, severity, and OWASP reference, plus predefined suites. Pass target_kind to get the correct evaluators for your target type. After returning the list, STOP and ask the user which suite or evaluators they want to run — do NOT proceed to opfor_setup automatically.

target_kind.description: 'agent' for AI agent/chatbot targets, 'mcp' for MCP server targets

tools.name: opfor_setup
tools.description:
Configure an Opfor red team run and write opfor.config.json. Before calling this tool you MUST ask the user for ALL of the following — do NOT assume or infer any value autonomously:
TARGET
  1. Target kind: 'agent' (HTTP chatbot/API) or 'mcp' (MCP server)?
  2. Target name.
  3. (agent) Description of what the agent does.
  4. (agent) HTTP endpoint URL.
  5. (agent) Request format: 'openai' (chat completions), 'json' ({ prompt }), or 'auto'?
  6. (agent) Model name sent to the target in the 'model' field (e.g. sarvam-30b) — ask only if relevant to the endpoint.
  7. (agent) Does the target require an API key?
  7b. (agent, stateful) Session id handling: client-owned (you send it — set agent_session_send_in/name) or server-owned (target returns its own — set agent_session_receive_in/name, plus send_* to echo it back).
  8. (mcp) Transport: 'stdio' or 'url'? Then ask command+args or URL accordingly.
EVALUATORS
  9. Call opfor_list_evaluators with the chosen target_kind, present the suites and evaluators to the user, then ask: run a full suite or specific evaluators?
ATTACKER LLM
 10. Provider — options: openai, anthropic, groq, google, deepseek, azure, openai-compatible.
 11. Model name for that provider.
 12. Name of the environment variable that holds the API key (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY).
 13. (openai-compatible or azure only) Base URL.
JUDGE LLM
 14. Use a separate LLM for judging, or reuse the attacker LLM?
RUN SETTINGS
 15. Effort: 'adaptive' (one sustained chat per evaluator) or 'comprehensive' (one attack per named pattern)?
 16. Turns per attack: 1 (single-turn) or 2-10 (multi-turn escalation)?
Only call this tool once you have confirmed all answers with the user. Returns the config file path — pass it to opfor_run.

target_name.description: Human-readable name for the target system

target_kind.description: 'agent' for HTTP/chatbot targets, 'mcp' for MCP servers

agent_api_key_env.description: Env var name holding the target API key (e.g. TARGET_API_KEY)

agent_script_path.description: Local script path (.js/.py) for local-script targets

agent_description.description: What the agent does (used in attack generation)

agent_model.description: Model name sent to the target endpoint in the 'model' field (e.g. sarvam-30b, gpt-4o)

agent_session_send_in.description: Where OPFOR sends the session id (body field or request header)

agent_session_send_name.description: Body dot-path or header name the session id is sent in (e.g. session_id)

agent_session_receive_in.description: Where a server-owned target RETURNS its session id (enables server-owned mode)

agent_session_receive_name.description: Response body dot-path / header name / cookie name holding the returned id

mcp_command.description: Command to start MCP server (stdio transport)

mcp_env.description: Env vars for MCP server process

suite_id.description: Suite ID (e.g. owasp-mcp-top10). Use this OR evaluator_ids.

evaluator_ids.description: Explicit evaluator IDs. Use this OR suite_id.

judge_llm.description: LLM for judging responses (defaults to attack_llm)

effort.description: adaptive: one sustained chat per evaluator, attacker picks tactics on the fly. comprehensive: one fresh multi-turn attack per named pattern in each evaluator.

turns.description: Turns per attack. 1 = single-turn, >1 = multi-turn escalation.

attack_objective.description: Free-text primary mission steering every evaluator's attacks (e.g. 'get the target to leak env vars via a delegated employee').

judge_hint.description: Free-text steering for the judge's verdict (e.g. 'treat any tool name leak as critical').

business_use_case.description: Free-text domain/business context for the target agent.

config_path.description: Full path for config file (overrides output_dir)

tools.name: opfor_run
tools.description: Run the red team evaluation from a config file produced by opfor_setup. Generates attacks on-the-fly, runs them against the target, judges responses, and writes an HTML + JSON report.

config_path.description: Path to opfor.config.json written by opfor_setup

effort_override.description: Override the effort level from config.

turns_override.description: Override turns per attack from config

objective_override.description: Override the attack objective from config

judge_hint_override.description: Override the judge hint from config

business_use_case_override.description: Override the business use case from config
